title: Overhead Pass Over a Defender
description: Players practise the two-hand overhead pass needed to deliver the ball over a defender's reach, a pass used constantly given how much of the court is contested at chair height.

content.objective: Deliver an accurate overhead pass that clears a defender's reach without floating too high.
content.setup: Two passers face each other with a defender between them, hands up but not jumping.
instructions: Bring the ball overhead with both hands before releasing.
Step and release in one motion, aiming slightly ahead of the receiver.
The receiver catches ready to shoot or pass immediately.
Rotate the defender every six passes.
coachingPoints: Release from behind the head, not from the chest.
Keep the pass firm — a lazy, floaty pass gets picked off.
Catch with the chair already squared to the next target.
commonMistakes: Winding up too long before releasing, telegraphing the pass.
Throwing it flat instead of with enough height to clear the defender.
Telegraphing the pass with the eyes before releasing it.
content.safety: The defender's hands stay up only — no reaching into the passer's lap.
